title: SolutionView Dependency Graph
description: Output contract for `solutionview scan`. Describes a .NET solution's project graph and each project's direct package references. Transitive package dependencies are out of scope for v1 (see docs/adr/0006-v1-scope.md).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this JSON contract. Bump on any breaking shape change; this file describes exactly 1.0.

generated.description: UTC timestamp of the scan, ISO-8601 (e.g. 2026-09-27T10:00:00Z).

solution.description: Absent (null) when scanning a single .csproj directly, without a .sln.

id.description: Assigned by the scanner by sorting projects by path before enumeration, so it is deterministic across scans of an unchanged solution (see ADR-0007). Not an MSBuild/.sln GUID.

path.description: Relative to the solution root, forward slashes.

targetFrameworks.description: One entry per TFM; more than one for multi-targeted projects.

id.description: Assigned by the scanner by sorting packages by (name, version) before enumeration, for the same determinism reason as project id (ADR-0007).

project.description: Must match a projects[].id. This is the source node for the edges below.

projectDependency.description: IDs into projects[] — direct ProjectReferences of this project.

packageDependency.description: IDs into packages[] — direct PackageReferences of this project. Direct only; no transitive package edges in v1 (ADR-0006).
